views.label: A short window
views.note: Obligations arrive in stages over a short window, so the stack has to exist before the dates.

views.label: Live now
views.note: The Digital Omnibus is in force and GPAI enforcement is live, both since summer 2026.

views.label: The deferred deadlines
views.note: The Omnibus deferred the high-risk obligations to 2027 and 2028, giving runway, not relief.

cards.title: Two moves in one summer
items: The Digital Omnibus entered into force on 27 July 2026 and reset the high-risk clock
GPAI enforcement went live on 2 August 2026, with fines up to 3% of turnover or EUR 15 million
The law began asking for engineered evidence

cards.title: Runway, not relief
items: Annex III high-risk obligations moved to 2 December 2027
Annex I embedded high-risk moved to 2 August 2028
The extra time is more runway to do the engineering, not less of it

cards.title: What to do with it
items: Pick the next stage and map its obligations to artefacts in chapter 08
Build the stack before the dates, not after them
